claims.behavior_proved: The authenticated API returns only current persisted, same-tenant identity/membership/appointment/capacity/platform/institutional/delegation/enrolment facts derived from the opaque server session. Person and account identities remain separate. Cooperative membership is independent from office appointments. Current chairperson, vice-chairperson, secretary and treasurer appointments resolve as typed authority facts. Expired appointments and grants are omitted; Union TA scope requires the persisted role, active delegation, still-active programme-manager role and matching persisted manager scope. The API returns no account email or person PII and denies forced-change sessions.
claims.path_proved: A real Fastify API integration uses symphony_app against PostgreSQL and asserts session identity cannot be overridden by a userId query parameter. It verifies current persisted identity, membership, appointment, capacity, platform, institutional, delegation and enrolment facts, including expired/revoked filtering and no account email/PII leakage. This evidence is limited to the WP2.2 trusted authority resolver; persona navigation and verified-finding presentation are owned by WP6.1.
claims.configuration_proved: Local synthetic test mode only. PostgreSQL is 18.0; resolver operations run as symphony_app in a read-only repeatable-read transaction with transaction-local app.tenant_id. The runtime role has SELECT-only access to the five resolver source tables and the global position catalogue. Fixture setup uses the isolated test administrator path.
coverage_limitations: WP2.2 is a trusted read model. It does not implement account/person link, membership, appointment, capacity, institutional-role or delegation grant/revoke commands.
Member activity and household data-entry workflows remain unimplemented; their current screens are explicit capability gaps and this task does not add member-data persistence.
Programme-manager projection is the owner-directed interim same-tenant universal read projection. Production multi-party deployment should replace it with explicit organization agreements/scopes.
Union TA scope is persisted as direct cooperative organization IDs because no cohort aggregate/lifecycle exists; cohort command lifecycle is deferred to WP2.3/WP2.4.
Workspace persona mapping and verified-finding display are separate WP6.1 acceptance and are not claimed as WP2.2 implementation.

limitations: Implementation and test results are not yet pinned to an immutable candidate commit. Gate verification remains pending until exact-candidate verification succeeds.
The WP6.1 predecessor is not gate-closed by this record. WP6.1 independently owns persona presentation and verified-item provenance acceptance.
reviewer: Implementation self-review; the owner supplied the universal projection direction and the account/person, member, persona and Union-TA scope direction. Independent task review remains outstanding.
